# PMI Klinik for psykoser - Midt

PMI Klinik for psykoser - Midt is a clinical unit appearing in the Danish ADHD quality database's 2024 report, where it is evaluated against two of the database's performance indicators. The unit's most notable result is its performance on **Indikator 10**, which measures the share of adult treatment courses in which a patient's need for social support has been assessed within 120 days of the start of treatment. PMI Klinik for psykoser - Midt achieved only 42 percent fulfillment (with a confidence interval of 34–49 percent, based on 76 out of 183 treatment courses), well below the national quality target of 90 percent [^src1].

This shortfall places the unit alongside many others nationally, since Indikator 10 was reported for the first time in the 2024 database and revealed widespread gaps in compliance — 37 percent at the national level and a regional range of 14–52 percent [^src1]. The steering group behind the ADHD database discussed possible causes for the low fulfillment rates, including registration practices and data quality issues from child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals, and decided to work on improving registration practices going forward [^src1].

The unit also appears in the report's data for a separate metric — recorded as 79 percent (confidence interval 72–84 percent), based on 144 out of 183 cases — in a table set within the discussion of **Indikator 11**, which measures the share of adult treatment courses in which the patient is receiving ADHD medication within 120 days of starting a care pathway. Indikator 11 was itself reported for adults for the first time in 2024, following the ADHD database's expansion that year to include adult patients [^src2]. Regional results for this indicator varied widely nationally, from 85 percent in Region Nordjylland to 37 percent in Region Hovedstaden, a gap the report attributes more likely to registration difficulties than to real differences in clinical practice [^src2].

Beyond these two data points, no further details, relationships, or timeline events involving PMI Klinik for psykoser - Midt are present in the corpus.
